council.title: The Small Council
council.chancellorDesc: Client relations, scoping, and the occasional difficult conversation about deadlines.
council.stewardDesc: Budgets, timelines, and keeping a project's scope from quietly doubling.
council.spymasterDesc: Debugging, QA, and finding the one edge case everyone else missed.
council.physicianDesc: Maintenance, patches, and keeping a site healthy long after launch.
council.bio:
One person holds every office above - no court, no retinue, just a developer who handles both sides of the work: client websites that need speed and clarity, and personal builds of games or mechanics designed from scratch.
 Currently sworn to React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with Astro for lighter holdings.
